christmas.note: Gelato published order-by deadline is 16 Dec Economy for all relevant DE categories. For the requested stricter tick, BOTH approval/processing date and latest arrival must be <= 16 Dec. Posterflow has no published 2026 cutoff found; fallback latest arrival <= 23 Dec, 1 calendar day before Christmas Eve. Tick is an estimate, never a guarantee. Calendar also retains its earlier 10 Dec store deadline.

holidays.policy: Conservative union of German national and regional public holidays; also skip 24 and 31 Dec operational closures. German-destination estimate, not a claim of German manufacture. Gelato can route through PL/CZ; include their relevant public holidays too.

gelato-poster.basis: 24 Nov Berlin quotes for all 11 live print formats (30x40, 45x60, 50x70 cm; five papers), every offered method: 30x40 Premium Matte, both Semi-Gloss papers and Museum-Quality are now printed in Poland and sent as Kleinpaket, 3-6 calendar days; 30x40 Classic Matte and every 45x60 and 50x70 print come from Germany by DHL Parcel, 2-3 days. Range 3-6 calendar days covers the slowest common route (the standard 30x40 poster), +1 German delivery business day margin. Requote after 7 days. See output/store/delivery-requote-20261124/QUOTES_20261124.json.

gelato-tee.basis: 24 Nov Berlin quotes for all 45 live garment model x colour combinations (one size each) and both tote bag colours, every offered method: tees 3-10, hoodies 6-9, tote bags 6-8 calendar days (cheapest route per item: Kleinpaket 6-8, DHL Parcel 7-8, Standard delivery 5-10); range 6-10 calendar days +1 German delivery business day margin covers it, unchanged from 20 Nov. Requote after 7 days. See output/store/delivery-requote-20261124/QUOTES_20261124.json.

gelato-mounted.basis: 11 Nov DE quotes and live 5-8 business-day profile, plus 1 buffer. Production+shipping bundled; approval unbounded, range conditional.

gelato-calendar.basis: Live Wix DE 5-8 working days includes approval; add 1 buffer. Manual approval unbounded, conditional.

posterflow-poster.basis: Provider same-day production before12, allow peak2; DHL sample next-day, conservative1-2 shipping +1buffer. Approval not SLA.
